title: Triata Capital Monica Hsiao：长端锚定下，10年期收益率难破5%
speaker: Monica Shell

segments.en: so there is still a lot of demand there and you know the last auction of the 10-year treasury was actually pretty healthy demand you could see and then of course you also have the best in buyback and the buyback in itself in my opinion hasn't made much impact and probably will not
segments.zh: 所以那里仍然有大量需求，你知道上次10年期国债拍卖实际上需求相当健康，你可以看到。当然还有回购，但在我看来，回购本身并没有产生太大影响，可能也不会。

segments.en: the last buyback was up to 6 billion but they only purchased back 5.19 billion and you know for looking you're going to see tranches of probably 4 to 6 billion buyback but you know you are doing this at the expense of having to fund it in the front end and your front end is going up
segments.zh: 上次回购规模高达60亿美元，但他们只回购了51.9亿美元。未来你可能会看到每批40到60亿美元的回购，但这样做是以前端融资为代价的，而前端利率正在上升。

segments.en: so then you're really looking at just the benefit of buying back some duration at lower dollar price in my opinion for the credit markets you know we're not going to see any big tightening of spreads in the short term obviously we've stayed in range which is pretty incredible if you think about how much supply the market has had to absorb
segments.zh: 所以在我看来，你真正看到的只是以较低价格回购一些久期的好处。对于信用市场，短期内我们不会看到利差大幅收窄，显然我们一直处于区间内，考虑到市场不得不吸收的供应量，这相当令人难以置信。

segments.en: so you know I think it's quite impressive the amount of liquidity that is still out there and you know I think we're going to have probably a slow drift a bit wider in spreads and then you know there is a big difference between investment grade and high yield
segments.zh: 所以我认为市场上仍然存在的流动性规模相当惊人，我认为我们可能会看到利差缓慢地略微扩大，然后投资级和高收益之间有很大区别。

segments.en: I think that in investment grade there will continue to be a demand on an all-end yield basis with some caution on duration on the high yield side it's going to be very important to do name picking very very idiosyncratic
segments.zh: 我认为投资级将继续在全端收益率基础上存在需求，但对久期要有所谨慎。在高收益方面，精选个券将非常重要，非常非常特殊。
